intro: Crystalized Scales are the hardened, mineralized hides harvested from basilisks dwelling in harsh Kalimdor environments such as the Charred Vale and Thousand Needles. When ground into a fine powder, these unusual scales serve as an exotic magical reagent coveted by spellcasters in Stormwind.

p: Basilisks that endure extreme environmental heat and ash—particularly those dwelling within Stonetalon's Charred Vale or the shimmering salt flats of Thousand Needles—develop rigid, crystal-encrusted hides. These crystalized scales possess latent arcane resonance, making them exceptionally valuable to scholarly wizards across the Great Sea who experiment with rare spellcraft.

In the human kingdom of Stormwind, the mage Collin Mauren actively seeks out adventurers journeying into the Kalimdor frontier to secure these scales. By pulverizing the crystalline mineral layers into dust, Mauren utilizes the particulate material as a vital reagent for newly conceived spells and personal arcane research.
